scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded father gestures as three children sit around him listening beneath an olive tree, with stone walls and distant hills in warm sunlight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 4:1, in which children are called to hear a father's instruction and pay attention to gain understanding.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded teacher gestures while handing a rolled blank parchment to a child; three other children listen in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of good teaching being given and held close, reflecting Proverbs 4:2's appeal not to forsake the teacher's instruction.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young boy sits between his father and mother in a sunlit stone courtyard. His father rests a hand on his shoulder, and his mother touches his arm as they smile at him. An olive tree, pottery, and woven textiles surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative family scene evokes the tender son of his father and the one cherished in his mother's sight in Proverbs 4:3.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a father gestures as he speaks to a boy seated beside him, who listens with one hand over his heart. An olive tree, flowers, and distant hills frame them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father teaching his son to hold his words in his heart, keep his commands, and live (Proverbs 4:4).

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man speaks with his arm around a boy as they walk on a sunlit path, and the boy looks up at him. A narrower trail winds into brush nearby, with flowers, trees, hills, and a village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene of a father teaching his son suggests Proverbs 4:5's call to seek wisdom and understanding, remember, and not turn away from the speaker's words.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a head covering and green cloak walks hand in hand with a young traveler along a rocky hillside path, holding her cloak around his shoulders. Olive trees, a distant village and hills lie beneath a golden sunset.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative personification of Wisdom staying close and sheltering the traveler illustrates Proverbs 4:6's call to love and not forsake her, and its promise that she will preserve and keep you.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunny stone courtyard, an older teacher holds an olive sapling with its roots exposed and points to its leaves while a young traveler listens. A clay jug, bags, and coins rest beside the traveler, with trees and hills in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene connects the verse's call to get wisdom and understanding with a traveler who values learning amid his possessions.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On sunlit stone steps, a woman in a blue shawl embraces a man in a cream tunic and places a leafy wreath on his head. An olive tree, stone walls, distant buildings, and hills frame the scene.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom as a woman embracing and honoring a man, evoking Proverbs 4:8's call to exalt and embrace her and its promise of elevation and honor.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a woman in blue and cream robes offers an ornate golden crown to a seated young man wearing a garland of leaves and flowers; he smiles and reaches toward it.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Wisdom giving the ornament of grace and crown of glory described in Proverbs 4:9.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded man gestures toward a boy who looks up at him as they sit beneath an olive tree. A stone-lined path winds toward another large olive tree, with a distant village and blue hills in the sun.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a father speaking to his listening son, with the old olive tree and winding path suggesting the many years of life named in Proverbs 4:10.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older bearded teacher gestures toward a sunlit path while a young boy walks beside him and looks up. Olive trees, stone walls, hills, and a village surround the path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene expresses Proverbs 4:11’s teaching of the way of wisdom and leading in paths of right.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man in a cream tunic and rust-colored wrap runs along a sunlit dirt path while a bearded traveler walks behind him. Olive trees, wildflowers, and low stone walls line the path, with hills and a village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of free walking and sure-footed running illustrates Proverbs 4:12's promise that steps will not be hindered and that running will not lead to stumbling.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young learner holds a rolled scroll tightly to his chest while an older teacher gestures toward a winding path. They sit under a leafy tree above golden fields, a distant village, and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of holding fast to instruction and guarding it as life, inspired by Proverbs 4:13.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young traveler with a walking staff turns away at a fork and looks back at two men accosting another traveler beside a bag on the shaded path, with olive trees and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler avoiding a path of wrongdoing, reflecting Proverbs 4:14's warning against entering the path of the wicked or walking in the way of evil.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler in a cream tunic and green cloak walks along a sunlit path, raising a hand toward a dark, thorn-lined trail that leads between rocks. A village and hills lie beyond the bright landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 4:15: the traveler turns away from a dark path and passes on, echoing the verse's call to avoid it and not travel on it.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men sit awake beside a lamp and a rolled sleeping mat in a moonlit stone village; one holds a rope across the lane while a traveler trips over it.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays sleepless wrongdoing and someone being made to stumble, reflecting the verse and its read-form gloss.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a lamplit stone room, one man bites bread while another drinks from a metal cup at a low table set with bread and grapes. A torn pouch spills coins beside a broken staff, and a traveler looks back from the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 4:17: the bread and cup evoke the verse's bread of wickedness and wine of violence, while the broken staff and scattered coins suggest harm and wrongdoing.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two travelers in robes walk along a rocky path from the shade of trees toward a sunlit valley and a distant hillside village beneath a bright sun.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of Proverbs 4:18, where the path of the just is compared to light that grows brighter until full day.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two robed travelers on a rocky path at night: one reaches out as he stumbles near a stone, while a worried companion follows. A moon and distant village appear beyond the dark hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of Proverbs 4:19, where the way of the wicked is like darkness and they do not know what makes them stumble.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A boy rests his chin on his hand and looks up at an older man seated beside him, who has an arm around the boy and gestures with an open hand. They sit in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree, with clay vessels, distant houses, and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined father and son illustrate Proverbs 4:20's invitation to attend to the speaker's words and incline one's ear to his sayings.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father gestures toward his son on a sunlit stone terrace. The son looks at him with one hand over his glowing chest; olive trees and hills stretch behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a son keeping his father's teaching in view and in his heart, echoing Proverbs 4:21.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man gestures as he speaks to a younger man with a hand over his heart, beside a flowing spring among olive trees and flowers in a sunlit garden.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a father's counsel and a flourishing garden to evoke the life and health that Proverbs 4:22 associates with finding his words.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man tends the stone wall around a heart-shaped pool as clear water flows into a sunlit garden of flowers, grain, and olive trees, with hills and a village beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of guarding the heart as a protected spring whose waters nourish life, reflecting Proverbs 4:23.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in a cream robe and rust-colored shawl stands in a sunlit stone courtyard, one hand on his chest and the other extended toward a dark tangle of threads drifting away. Olive branches, pottery, and distant stone buildings surround him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of putting deceitful and perverse speech far away, as Proverbs 4:24 advises.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young traveler carrying a pack and walking stick looks ahead along a sunlit path through olive trees and rocky hills toward a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of looking ahead, echoing Proverbs 4:25 and its call for the eyes to look straight before you.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A sandal-clad traveler pauses among rocks, looking down at his feet beside a stone road that winds through sunlit hills toward a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 4:26's call to ponder the path of one's feet and let one's ways be established.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler in a cream tunic and rust-colored cloak walks along a sunlit path, lifting a sandaled foot beside dark thorny brambles. Olive trees, a hillside village, and mountains lie ahead.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of a traveler keeping to a path and moving a foot away from thorns, reflecting the verse's instruction not to turn right or left and to remove one's foot from evil.
